hook.say: Turkey is packed with UNESCO World Heritage sites. Five questions. The last one stumps even history fans!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: What does the name Pamukkale mean?
questions.say: What does the name Pamook-kaleh mean?
questions.fact: Its white terraces are travertine left by hot spring water.
questions.sayAnswer: Cotton Castle! Its white terraces are made of travertine, left by hot spring water.

questions.q: The Library of Celsus stands in which ancient city?
questions.say: The Library of Celsus stands in which ancient city?
questions.fact: Ephesus, in İzmir Province, joined the UNESCO list in 2015.
questions.sayAnswer: Ephesus! It is in Izmeer Province, and it joined the UNESCO list in 2015.

questions.q: Which UNESCO-listed town is famous for its Ottoman-era houses?
questions.say: Which UNESCO-listed town is famous for its Ottoman-era houses?
questions.fact: Safranbolu is named after saffron, once grown and traded there.
questions.sayAnswer: Saf-ran-bolu! It is named after saffron, which was once grown and traded there.

questions.q: Which 9,000-year-old Neolithic town was found near Konya?
questions.say: Which 9000 year old Stone Age town was found near Konya?
questions.fact: Most of its houses were entered through a hole in the roof.
questions.sayAnswer: Chatal-hoy-uk! Most of its houses were entered through a hole in the roof.

questions.q: The UNESCO-listed Great Mosque and Hospital of Divriği is in which province?
questions.say: The UNESCO-listed Great Mosque and Hospital of Div-ree is in which province?
questions.fact: Built in 1228-29, it was among Türkiye's first UNESCO sites in 1985.
questions.sayAnswer: See-vas! Built around 1228, it was among Turkey's first UNESCO sites in 1985.
